sql: SELECT t2.points, CAST(t1.learner_tally*t1.percent_overseas_learners AS REAL)/100 FROM college_annual t1 JOIN college_score_annual t2 ON t1.college_identifier=t2.college_identifier WHERE t1.college_identifier=100 AND t2.annual=2015

SELECT DISTINCT t1.nation_label FROM nation t1 JOIN college t2 ON t1.identifier=t2.nation_identifier JOIN college_annual t3 ON t2.identifier=t3.college_identifier WHERE t3.annual=2013 AND t3.learner_tally*100 > (SELECT AVG(learner_tally) FROM college_annual)*98
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM college_annual t1 JOIN college_score_annual t2 ON t1.college_identifier=t2.college_identifier WHERE t2.points=90 AND t1.annual=2011

SELECT SUM(t1.learner_tally) - SUM(CAST(t1.learner_tally*t1.percent_overseas_learners AS REAL)/100) FROM college_annual t1 JOIN college t2 ON t1.college_identifier=t2.identifier WHERE t2.college_label='Harvard University' AND t1.annual BETWEEN 2011 AND 2012

SELECT CAST(t1.learner_tally*t1.percent_overseas_learners AS REAL)/100 FROM college_annual t1 JOIN college t2 ON t1.college_identifier=t2.identifier WHERE t2.college_label='Harvard University' AND t1.annual=2012

SELECT CAST(t1.learner_tally*t1.percent_woman_learners AS REAL)/100 FROM college_annual t1 JOIN college t2 ON t1.college_identifier=t2.identifier WHERE t2.college_label='Stanford University' AND t1.annual=2011

SELECT t1.learner_tally - CAST(t1.learner_tally*t1.percent_woman_learners AS REAL)/100 FROM college_annual t1 JOIN college t2 ON t1.college_identifier=t2.identifier WHERE t2.college_label='Emory University' AND t1.annual=2011

SELECT n.nation_label, CAST(a.learner_tally*a.percent_woman_learners AS REAL)/100 FROM college_annual a JOIN college c ON a.college_identifier=c.identifier JOIN nation n ON n.identifier=c.nation_identifier WHERE a.annual=2011 AND a.college_identifier=23

SELECT DISTINCT c.college_label FROM college c JOIN college_score_annual s ON s.college_identifier=c.identifier WHERE s.annual=2015 AND s.points*100 < (SELECT AVG(points) FROM college_score_annual WHERE annual=2015)*28
